nodes.label: API Rate Limiting
nodes.rationale: In-memory rate limiter, 100 req/min per IP, resets on deployment; Redis integration planned for persistence.

nodes.label: Defense in Depth Security Architecture
nodes.rationale: Layered security model: network (rate limit, IP block), application (Zod validation, auth, XSS), data (RLS, encrypted secrets), infrastructure (CSP, HTTPS).

nodes.label: Avatar Bucket Public-to-Private Fix
nodes.rationale: Avatar storage bucket changed from public to private with signed/public URL retrieval to prevent unauthorized access to user avatars (2026-03-16).

nodes.label: Two Steps Studio AI Developer Instructions
PLN Currency Info
nodes.rationale: Exchange rate fixed at 0.01 PLN = 10000 coins (1 PLN = 10,000,000 coins), used for shop balances and real-money rewards.

nodes.label: Debugging Workflow Rule
nodes.rationale: Mandated 7-step process (read error, locate file/line, inspect, check imports, identify root cause, minimal fix, validate) to avoid patching errors blindly.

nodes.label: Critical Change Rules
nodes.rationale: Requires explicit confirmation before changing DB structure, deleting files, replacing architecture, changing auth, or modifying payment/economy systems.

nodes.label: Architecture Rules (Avoid Overengineering)
nodes.rationale: Before creating new services/hooks/managers/tables, check whether existing systems can be extended; prefer extension over parallel systems.

nodes.label: Conventional Commits
nodes.rationale: Adopts Conventional Commits (type(scope): description) to keep history consistent and machine-parseable.

nodes.label: Database Contribution Rules
nodes.rationale: Requires migrations for schema changes, RLS verification per table, no manual production DB edits; a feature is not complete if it only works with security policies disabled.

nodes.label: Development Principles
nodes.rationale: Keep It Simple, Build for Maintainability, Reuse Existing Systems, Security First, Think About the User, Avoid Unrelated Changes.

nodes.label: CI/CD (GitHub Actions)
nodes.rationale: GitHub Actions workflow runs checkout, Node setup, npm ci, tests, and build on push/PR to gate changes.

nodes.label: System Implementation Plan (4 Phases)
nodes.rationale: Phase 1 analysis/assessment, Phase 2 refactoring/optimization, Phase 3 workflow enhancement, Phase 4 component system strengthening - designed to eliminate duplication and ensure maintainable architecture.

nodes.label: Vulnerability History
nodes.rationale: Log of fixed/in-progress issues: public avatar bucket (Critical, fixed), no email verification (High, fixed), missing rate limiting (Medium, in progress), unauthenticated /api/shop (High, fixed).

nodes.label: Known Issues (State)
nodes.rationale: OrganizationTree.tsx useMemo error, missing .env for tss-dc-bot, shop search input XSS risk, N+1 Supabase queries in some places.

nodes.label: Next.js Agent Rules Block
nodes.rationale: Auto-generated notice ('This is NOT the Next.js you know') warning that the installed Next.js version has breaking API/convention changes vs training data; instructs reading node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing code; the block is re-added by `next dev` so it should be committed to keep the tree clean.

nodes.label: Organizations RLS Violation
nodes.rationale: RLS policy required created_by = auth.uid() while the trigger also expected the frontend to set created_by, causing a conflict; frontend should not manage created_by, that duplicated the trigger's job and lacked spoof protection.

nodes.label: handle_new_organization() Trigger
nodes.rationale: SECURITY DEFINER trigger auto-sets created_by from auth.uid() when NULL, rejects mismatched created_by (except service_role), and auto-creates the owner membership row via ON CONFLICT upsert.

nodes.label: handle_new_project() Trigger
nodes.rationale: Mirrors handle_new_organization(): auto-sets created_by, validates against spoofing, and auto-creates project owner membership.

nodes.label: Frontend Logic Duplication
nodes.rationale: organizations/route.ts and projects/route.ts manually set created_by and manually inserted owner membership rows that the trigger already creates, risking inconsistency, extra queries, and race conditions; removed in favor of relying on the trigger.

nodes.label: created_by Spoofing Protection
nodes.rationale: Trigger raises an exception if NEW.created_by does not match auth.uid() (unless the caller is service_role), preventing a user from attributing a row to another user.

nodes.label: Migration Safety Confirmation
nodes.rationale: Migration only uses ALTER TABLE/CREATE FUNCTION/CREATE POLICY, never drops tables or truncates data, is idempotent (IF NOT EXISTS/ON CONFLICT), avoids RLS recursion via STABLE SECURITY DEFINER helpers, and backfills owners for existing rows.

nodes.label: Context Layer
nodes.rationale: Guidon's core feature: tracks Decisions, Relations, Sources, and Memory so teams understand why a project exists, not just its tasks.

nodes.label: Permission System
nodes.rationale: Role-based access control: organization roles (owner/admin/member) and project roles (owner/admin/developer/tester/viewer) with granular permission checks.

nodes.label: Storage System
nodes.rationale: Storage quotas of 5GB per project and 50GB per organization across guidon-files, guidon-attachments, guidon-exports buckets, auto-created on first use.

nodes.label: 005_project_creator_and_drift.sql
nodes.rationale: Fixes projects.created_by being silently NULL, backfills it from the owner membership, and adds the live-only function set_organization_creator to the repo.

nodes.label: 006_fix_service_role_detection.sql
nodes.rationale: 005 detected the service role via current_user, which inside SECURITY DEFINER is the function owner and never matches; replaced with a JWT-claim check (private.is_service_role()).

nodes.label: 007_allow_parent_delete.sql
nodes.rationale: Last-owner guards fired on ON DELETE CASCADE, making projects/organizations impossible to delete; fix skips the guard when the parent row is already gone.

nodes.label: Missing Baseline Schema (000)
nodes.rationale: 001_initial_schema.sql only alters the schema, it does not CREATE TABLE; there is no baseline, so a fresh Supabase project cannot be provisioned from the migration files alone. Writing 000_baseline_schema.sql is outstanding; the live database, not 001, is the source of truth until then.

nodes.label: current_user Is Not the Caller (SECURITY DEFINER pitfall)
nodes.rationale: Inside a SECURITY DEFINER function, current_user is the function owner, so current_user = 'service_role' is never true; 001 uses this comparison three times as dead code (each ANDed with auth.uid() IS NOT NULL, already false for service-role requests). Use private.is_service_role() instead.

nodes.label: AFTER INSERT Trigger Timing Issue
nodes.rationale: on_organization_created and on_project_created are AFTER INSERT triggers, so assigning NEW.<column> inside handle_new_organization()/handle_new_project() does nothing to the stored row; ownership columns need BEFORE triggers (004, 005) or a column DEFAULT to actually persist.
